name: nms-power-sim-desktop
description: 无人深空 · 电力模拟器 · Windows 便携桌面客户端
author: NMS Power Sim

scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run icon && set ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/electron-builder-binaries/&& electron-builder --win --x64 --publish=never
